fit_reason: Whole car (1979 Chrysler Cordoba project) sold by a private owner, though it is a long-stalled project car.
findings: Dull, chalky-looking white paint on the hood and front fenders
General dirt and grime along the lower doors, rocker trim and rear quarter
Dirty, dull chrome on the rear bumper and front bumper
Dusty rear window glass with a covered, cluttered-looking rear interior area
Peeling, deteriorated vinyl roof covering (needs replacement, not a detail fix)
Bare primer and filler patches on the doors (bodywork, not ours to fix)
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Cordoba T-top. The white paint on the hood and fenders looks chalky, and the chrome bumpers and lower trim have some built-up grime that a wash and buff could brighten up for photos and showings. We do mobile pre-sale details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
